items.title: SK Hynix Net Profit Hits Record; Other Metrics Disappoint
items.summary: SK Hynix’s second-quarter net profit surged 13-fold on strong demand for advanced chips, but its overall results fell short of high market expectations.

items.title: Bloom Energy Boosts Outlook as Profit, Sales Climb
items.summary: The provider of fuel-cell technology raised its fiscal 2026 revenue and adjusted earnings per share guidance, as it posted a profit of $196.3 million.

items.title: Teradyne Profit Soars on Semiconductor Testing Demand
items.summary: Teradyne reported higher second-quarter revenue and profit as the artificial intelligence boom fueled growth in its business providing testing equipment for semiconductors.

items.title: Seagate Profit Soars as AI Boom Drives Data Storage Demand
items.summary: The mass-capacity data storage company reported net income of $1.29 billion, or $5.58 a share, up from $488 million, or $2.24 a share the year prior.

items.title: 📈 Earnings Snippet: Sherwin-Williams
items.summary: The paint maker's sales rose 7.5% to $6.79 billion in the recent quarter, ahead of the $6.6 billion that analysts polled by FactSet had expected.  Shares climbed more than 8%, making Sherwin-Williams the top performer in the Dow industrials in what's poised to be the stock's biggest one-day increase in more than four years.

items.title: PayPal Lifts Full-Year Adjusted Earnings Outlook Following Second-Quarter Beat
items.summary: PayPal (PYPL) raised its full-year adjusted earnings guidance after reporting second-quarter results

items.title: JetBlue Eyes More Aircraft Financing If High Fuel Costs Persist
items.summary: The carrier’s net loss widened to $247 million in the second quarter, from a loss of $74 million in the same period in 2025.

items.title: Royal Caribbean Says Geopolitical Tensions Moderated Bookings
items.summary: Royal Caribbean Group cut its revenue outlook for the year, as prolonged geopolitical uncertainty hurt bookings in the second quarter.
